cleared_rows_about: Owner decisions 2026-11-03/04: an admitted row that NAMES an excluded setup is withheld pending provenance and rights review (see excluded_setup_mentions). A row is served only after review, listed here as {kb_id, content_sha, provenance_ref, rights_review_ref, approved_by, approved_on}: every field required, approved_by a name, approved_on an ISO date not in the future, content_sha the sha256 the index records for the reviewed text (a changed text loses its clearance). Empty: nothing is cleared yet.

excluded_setup_mentions.about: Owner directive 2026-11-04 (withhold uncertain; a commentary label never makes restricted content permissible): 'withhold' = every admitted row that names an excluded setup is withheld unless it is on cleared_rows. 'serve_flagged' (owner only) re-admits rows WITHOUT definitional wording as a block, served flagged commentary_only; definitional rows stay withheld either way.

calc_date_rule: Every served record figure carries its calculation date (as_of). It is read ONLY from the source's calc_date_field, which must be on the code's allow-list (computed_at, calculated_at, calc_date, calculation_date, computation_date, updated_at) AND have a calc_date_attestation. Missing, or more than 15 minutes in the future -> undated_record; older than pack.stats_stale_days -> stale_record; neither serves a figure.
